newsitem.title: USA: PMI SECOND QUARTER RESULTS LED BY NET PREMIUMS.
newsitem.headline: PMI SECOND QUARTER RESULTS LED BY NET PREMIUMS.

text.p: The PMI Group said total revenue growth for the second quarter was led by net premiums earned of $109.9 million, which rose 15 percent over the prior year period, and net investment income of $20.7 million, an increase of 17 percent over the prior year period.
PMI reported second quarter operating earnings per share, excluding capital gains, of $1.24, up 13 percent over the $1.10 per share reported in the second quarter of 1996.

Excluding the effect of a $1.4 million adjustment in call premiums on pre-refunded tax-exempt securities in the prior year period, the Company's operating earnings per share were 16 percent above the second quarter of 1996. Wednesday, 16 July 1997 13:17:02 ENDS nN16216319
